RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Panel composition on its own is not evidence of anything. All-female panels occur by chance regularly in broadcasting, where women are well represented in news management, just as all-male panels did for decades. Raising it would signal that you believe you were entitled to the job and would likely harden attitudes toward you — including among people you may work with or need as referees.

The substantive point is different and worth pressing: your seniority and years were not matched, and "strong experience of digital media" is vague. Chase the written explanation in writing, copy HR, cite any internal recruitment policy on feedback timescales, and ask for the scoring against the published criteria. If the scoring is incoherent or undocumented, you have something real. The panel's sex isn't it.
